Overview

Website Development, explained

Your website is often the first impression a customer has of your business. If it's slow, hard to use on a phone or hard to find on Google, people leave before they ever call.

We design and build fast, mobile-first websites and online stores that make it easy for customers to understand what you do and get in touch. Every site is built with search in mind, so it's ready to rank from launch, and set up so you can update it yourself.

Who it's for

  • Businesses with an outdated or slow website
  • New businesses that need a professional site quickly
  • Businesses wanting to sell online
  • Anyone whose site doesn't bring in enquiries

Why it matters

Why Website Development matters for your business

Most customers check your website before they call, book or buy. In a few seconds they decide whether you look trustworthy, whether you do what they need, and how to get in touch. A slow or confusing site loses them to a competitor.

Your website is also the foundation of your marketing. SEO, Google Ads, social media and email all send people to it. If it doesn't load fast and guide visitors to act, every marketing dollar works harder than it should.

We build websites to do a job: show what you offer clearly, rank in search, and turn visitors into enquiries. And because you own the site and its content, you're never stuck if you change providers.

Pricing

What affects the cost of Website Development

  • How many parts of your business the system covers (for example sales, jobs, stock and staff)
  • How many existing tools, files or databases we need to connect or migrate
  • Number of user types and the permissions each needs
  • Whether you need a mobile app, a customer portal, or both
  • Hosting, support and new features after launch (optional)

Every quote is itemised, in AUD or USD, and valid for 30 days.

Get a fixed quote

Getting started

What we'll need from you

  • A list of the apps and subscriptions you pay for today
  • A rough picture of how work moves through your business, from enquiry to invoice
  • Examples of the reports, forms and documents you use
  • Someone on your team who can answer questions and test as we build

Don't have all of this yet? That's fine. We'll work through it together in your free consultation.

FAQ

Website Development questions

Can you redesign our existing website?

Yes. We keep what's working, including your search rankings, and rebuild the rest.

Will I be able to update it myself?

Yes. We set it up so you can change text, images and products without a developer.

Will we lose our Google rankings with a new site?

We plan redirects and keep the content that ranks, to protect your existing search visibility.

Do you write the content?

We can. We'll work from your notes, or write it with you.

Can you connect the website to our other systems?

Yes. We can connect forms, stores and bookings to your CRM, accounting or custom software.

How many pages will our website need?

It depends on your services and audience. We recommend a page per main service, plus pages that answer customers' common questions.

Do you provide hosting?

Yes. We can host and maintain your site, including backups and security updates.

Can you add a blog?

Yes. A blog helps your SEO and gives customers useful information.
